scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cost.notes: First-year costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set G1/G5 (confirmed on Haverford's cost-of-attendance page): tuition $74,930, required fees $863 (Student Government Fee $552 + first-year Orientation Fee $311), food and housing $20,554 (housing $12,458 + meals $8,096). Estimated expenses: books $1,340, transportation $222, other $1,934 (other shown = transportation + other). Haverford's cost page lists total costs for first-year students of $100,026 including its own indirect budget (personal $1,864, additional meals $405, loan fees $70). Institutional aid for nonresidents is need-based only (CDS H6): 55 degree-seeking nonresidents received it, average $92,126.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 6,730 applied, 896 admitted, 397 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international, by known physical address at application) add up to the totals. International: 3,254 applied, 124 admitted, 44 enrolled. Test-optional, so the SAT/ACT percentiles describe the 40% (SAT) and 14% (ACT) of first-years who submitted scores. Haverford reports no high school GPA data (C11 and C12 are 'n/a'). Early decision (C21): 702 applications, 229 admitted. Undergraduate enrollment (1,420) is the B1 total of all undergraduates; the nonresident count (153) is the B2 'Total Undergraduates' cell for Nonresidents (Haverford's own international page counts 192 students with permanent addresses outside the U.S., 13.1%, a different definition).
